subject: history_social
passage: Although earlier inventors had tried to make a fastener that would close with a single ______ was the Swedish-born engineer Gideon Sundback who, in 1913, designed the row of interlocking metal teeth that made the modern zipper work. The name "zipper" came later, from a company that used the fasteners on rubber boots.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: "Although earlier inventors had tried to make a fastener that would close with a single pull" is a dependent clause—it begins with "Although" and can't stand alone. The main clause that completes it, "it was the Swedish-born engineer Gideon Sundback who … designed the row of interlocking metal teeth," follows after a comma.
explanation.A: Correct. A comma separates the introductory dependent clause from the main clause that completes the sentence.
explanation.B: Incorrect. A semicolon must have an independent clause on each side, and the "Although" clause can't stand alone.
explanation.C: Incorrect. An introductory dependent clause of this length must be set off from the main clause with a comma.
explanation.D: Incorrect. A period after "pull" leaves the "Although" clause standing alone as a fragment.
